schema.title: Samplesheet
schema.description: One row per pair of gzipped short-read FASTQ files (R1 and R2), next to the sample's long reads in a single gzipped FASTQ file. Rows with the same sample name, such as one per sequencing lane, have their short reads concatenated by the pipeline, and must name the same long-read file.

ID.title: Sample
ID.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

R1.title: Short-read FASTQ (R1)
R1.errorMessage: Must be a gzipped read FASTQ (.fastq.gz or .fq.gz) with no spaces in its name, not an I1/I2 index read

R2.title: Short-read FASTQ (R2)
R2.errorMessage: Must be a gzipped read FASTQ (.fastq.gz or .fq.gz) with no spaces in its name, not an I1/I2 index read

LongFastQ.title: Long-read FASTQ
LongFastQ.errorMessage: Must be a gzipped read FASTQ (.fastq.gz or .fq.gz) with no spaces in its name, not an I1/I2 index read
